gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly-diagnosed de novo GBM based on the absence of previous history of brain tumor (WHO Grade IV glioma) by histopathology or molecular studies.

candidate_evidence.quote: Ex-Vivo expanded autologous IL-8 receptor (CXCR2) modified CD70 CAR (8R-70CAR) T cells (other names: 8R-70CAR T cells): Single dose of 8R-70CAR T cells administered IV

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed CD70 positive adult GBM patients who have undergone surgery for maximal debulking

role_evidence.quote: Single dose of 8R-70CAR T cells administered IV

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous CD70-directed CAR T cells with CXCR2 (IL-8 receptor) modification

role_evidence.quote: Cohort 4 will receive Cy/Flu + CAR T cells at established maximum tolerated dose.
Cohort 4 will receive Cy/Flu + CAR T cells at established maximum tolerated dose.
Patients will then undergo standard of care chemoradiation.
Acute bacterial or fungal infection requiring intravenous antibiotics at the initiation of XRT/TMZ.

coder_notes: The only experimental agent is a CAR T cell product (excluded intervention type), so there is no candidate; CD70 is mechanistically matched to the CAR T cells but candidate_matched is false because the CAR T product is not a candidate. Cy/Flu is given only in cohort 4 as conditioning (supportive). Temozolomide is not named as an intervention; listed as soc_backbone because standard chemoradiation precedes CAR T in all patients (XRT/TMZ mentioned only in exclusion criteria), adjudicator may drop. Title also mentions paediatric HGG but eligibility criteria are for adult GBM only.
